settings.label: Hold to butter
settings.info: While it is held on the snow, the left stick's forward / back leans the rider and the board onto the nose / tail instead of tucking or braking. The game does not see this button then (RB alone opens the sport wheel when stopped, so a press while standing still or walking stays the game's).

settings.label: Board tilt at full stick
settings.info: The board's pitch the game is asked for (its own right stick asks up to 45 degrees); the game's pitch curves scale it down by speed and how deep the board sits.

settings.label: Weight shift at full stick
settings.info: How far the rider's weight goes over the nose / tail (the game's own forward lean at speed: 45).

settings.label: Stick response
settings.info: 1 = the lean follows the stick evenly; more = finer near the middle, the full lean only at the end of the stick.

settings.label: Start from
settings.info: A press slower than this belongs to the game (RB: the sport wheel).

settings.label: Also on skis
settings.info: Skis lean onto their tips / tails the same way.

settings.label: Log butters and animation clips
settings.info: Writes each butter and every animation clip the game picks meanwhile to the iSteep log (powder_overlay.log), and shows the lean.
